verdict.rationale: There is confirmed evidence of a desktop app (codex app) and of diff/summary inspection and parallel task running, but no evidence specifically describing a side-by-side multi-session UI in the desktop app, and community reports note the app is Mac-only and had launch/UX issues (stuck on 'Loading projects...'). Missing for 10: explicit description or screenshot of side-by-side session view in the desktop app, cross-platform desktop support, and hands-on confirmation that visual diff review works smoothly alongside parallel sessions.
